unit.title: Engineering a Reproducible k-Nearest-Neighbors Pipeline
prerequisites: Comfort with asymptotic analysis and basic data structures
Basic probability and linear algebra at the catalog's CS70/CS188 level
learning_objectives: Translate a mathematical classifier into an explicit, deterministic software contract
Prevent train/validation/test leakage in preprocessing and model selection
Build a repeatable command-line experiment with machine-readable provenance
Test numerical behavior, boundary cases, state ownership, and reproducibility
Explain the runtime and engineering tradeoffs of exact nearest-neighbor search

unit_completion_requires: Every required output exists and is attributable to the learner
The implementation and experiment pass independent deterministic validation
The submitted evidence satisfies the examiner-controlled threshold and mandatory gates
completion_policy.validator_authority: Only a validator controlled by the learning-factory worker harness may mark this unit complete.
